name: Goku Black Jayce
creator: mava
description:
Goku Black Jayce | Custom Skin Overview
This total conversion skin brings the Divine Justice to the Rift. Transforming Jayce into the iconic antagonist from Dragon Ball Super, this mod features high-quality assets and a unique stance-switching mechanic that mirrors Goku Black’s power progression.

Core Features
New 3D Models: Highly detailed models for both Base Form and Super Saiyan Rosé.

Custom Animations: Smooth, hand-crafted animations for attacks, abilities, and recalls.

VFX Overhaul: All-new visual effects using the signature dark purple and pink "Divine Ki" aesthetic.

Immersive SFX: Authentic sound effects from the anime, including the iconic ki blade hum and hit sounds.

The Two Faces of a God
The highlight of this skin is how it utilizes Jayce's stance-switching to represent Goku Black’s forms:

1. Melee Stance (Hammer): Super Saiyan Rosé
When switching to melee, Goku Black ascends to his Super Saiyan Rosé form.

The Weapon: Instead of a hammer, he wields the Scythe of Sorrow (the pink ki scythe).

Combat: Every strike leaves trails of pink energy. His "To the Skies!" (Q) becomes a devastating leap with the scythe.

2. Ranged Stance (Cannon): Base Form
In ranged mode, he reverts to his Base Form (Black Gi).

The Weapon: He uses his hands and the Time Ring to channel dark ki blasts.

Combat: His "Shock Blast" (Q) is replaced by a Black Power Ball. When fired through the "Acceleration Gate" (E), it turns into a massive, high-speed energy wave.
